baseline_observation.interpretation: The running game repeatedly submits its 13-draw disclaimer frame. The log counts completed COHER_STATUS_HOST waits; it does not directly count UI-thread dispatches or establish the cause of the unchanged screen.

change.behavior: Track retained asynchronous Vulkan frames atomically. A COHER_STATUS_HOST drain returns immediately, without a UI-thread dispatch, only when the renderer cache has no in-flight frames; otherwise it still drains every retained frame.
change.expected_effect: Avoid repeated synchronous UI-thread handoffs for dirty coherency writes after the renderer queue has already drained.
